content.rendered:
The Sherwood School District will be hosting the following Town Hall meetings on the topic of the Education Levy:

  • Thursday, April 6 – 11:30am-1:00pm at the District Office Board Room
  • Tuesday, April 18 – 5:30-7:00pm at the Archer Glen Elementary Cafeteria
  • Friday, May 12 – 9:00-10:30am at the Sherwood Police Department Community Room
